desc: No need for a tool box at the range when you have the Wheeler Delta Series Compact Multi-Tool. The multi-tool design can be used to perform many different functions in the field or at the range. When you need to make adjustments to your rifle or scrape some carbon build-up simply grab this all in one tool out of its nylon belt sheath . Features- AR Carbon Multi-Scraper Tool, 5/64 Hex, 7/64 Hex, 1/8 Hex, Pivot and takedown punch, #2 Phillips, bolt waist scraper, interior BCG scraper, T10 Torx, T15 Torx, T20 Torx, A2 front sight tool, 3/16 Flat, 3/4 Wrench, 1/2 Wrench and castle nut wrench. Nylon belt sheath included.
